The Extra in The Ordinary

Discovering the extraordinary stories hidden within everyday moments. An independent TEDx experience brought to life by the community of The Orbis School Mundhwa, Pune.

What is TEDx?

TED is a nonprofit organization devoted to Ideas Worth Spreading. Started as a four-day conference in California more than three decades ago, TED has grown to support its mission with multiple initiatives. The two annual TED Conferences invite the world's leading thinkers and doers to speak for 18 minutes or less.

TEDx was created in the spirit of TED's mission — “ideas worth spreading.” It supports independent organizers who want to create a TED-like event in their own community. A TEDx event is a local gathering where live TED-like talks and performances are shared with the community. TEDx events are fully planned and coordinated independently, on a community-by-community basis.

The TEDx programme is designed to help communities, organisations and individuals spark conversation and connection through local TED-like experiences. At TEDx events, a screening of TED Talks videos — or a combination of live presenters and TED Talks videos — sparks deep conversation and connections at the local level.

The Theme

THE EXTRA IN THE ORDINARY

Every single day, we walk past moments that seem unremarkable — a barista who remembers your order, a child's unfiltered question, a stranger's quiet act of kindness, the rhythm of a city waking up. What if we paused long enough to truly see them?

The Extra in The Ordinary celebrates the hidden sparks that live inside the mundane — inviting us to look closer at the people, places and routines we take for granted, and discover that the most extraordinary stories are often the ones unfolding right in front of us.

“The most beautiful things in life are not things at all — they are moments, people, memories and lessons. They are ordinary moments that, when seen truly, turn out to be extraordinary.”

The School

The Orbis School Mundhwa

Mundhwa, Pune

The Orbis School Mundhwa is a vibrant centre of learning that fosters academic excellence, character building and global citizenship. Rooted in the philosophy that every child carries unique potential, the school blends rigorous academics with creative expression, critical thinking and social responsibility.

From innovative pedagogy to a thriving culture of debate, art, sports and community service, Orbis nurtures young minds who don't just excel in classrooms — they question, create and lead.
